I am a single parent raising three sons on my own. My boys are 19, 15, and 9 years old. We are currently living in a one-bedroom flat, which is completely unworkable for us. I have been diagnosed with severe anxiety disorder and agoraphobia. My current flat is on a noisy and chaotic street, and being on the first floor means we get limited sunlight and have no garden or private outside area. My psychiatrist has confirmed in writing that my living conditions are a direct trigger for my symptoms, as they significantly limit my ability to function at home for most of the day. A change of housing to a quieter environment with access to green space would significantly improve my situation according to my care team. I have worked full time at the same local supermarket for exactly two years now, which has been a huge part of my recovery. After a conviction over a decade ago, I decided to turn my life around and have been building a life in this borough for 9 years now. My family is the most important thing to me, and I want to provide a better environment for us.

I am a single parent raising three sons on my own. My boys are 19, 15, and 9 years old. We are currently living in a one-bedroom flat, which is completely unworkable for us. I have been diagnosed with severe anxiety disorder and agoraphobia. My current flat is on a noisy and chaotic street, and being on the first floor means we get limited sunlight and have no garden or private outside area. My psychiatrist has confirmed in writing that my living conditions are a direct trigger for my symptoms, as they significantly limit my ability to function at home for most of the day. A change of housing to a quieter environment with access to green space would significantly improve my situation according to my care team. I have worked full time at the same local supermarket for exactly two years now, which has been a huge part of my recovery. After a conviction over a decade ago, I decided to turn my life around and have been building a life in this borough for 9 years now. My family is the most important thing to me, and I want to provide a better environment for us.
